name: Google Workspace directory users
description: Google Workspace user accounts as the Admin SDK Directory API's users resource: identity, name, admin and suspension state, contact methods and org placement, on the TA's own gws:users:identity input and on the GCP add-on's Pub/Sub-delivered directory:users sourcetype.
source: Google Admin SDK Directory API Users resource reference (developers.google.com); Splunk Add-on for Google Workspace and Splunk Add-on for Google Cloud Platform sourcetype docs; captured samples and indexed events.

feed.label: Google Workspace directory users
feed.description: One record per Google Workspace user account, as the Admin SDK Directory API's users().list() and users().get() return it: identity, name, admin flags, suspension state, contact methods and org placement. A directory snapshot, not an audit event: no field here says when something changed, only what the account currently holds.

resource_kind.label: Resource kind
resource_kind.description: The API resource's declared type. Both captured samples read directory#user.

user_id.label: User id
user_id.description: The directory-issued unique id for the account, usable as the userKey in a Directory API request URI.

primary_email.label: Primary email
primary_email.description: The account's primary email address; required and unique at creation, and the address the account signs in with.

full_name.label: Full name
full_name.description: The user's full name, formed by concatenating the first and last name values.

email_alias.label: Email alias
email_alias.description: One of the account's alias email addresses; mail to any of these reaches the same account.

non_editable_alias.label: Non-editable alias
non_editable_alias.description: An alias address outside the account's primary domain or sub-domain, kept read-only for backward compatibility.

secondary_email_address.label: Email entry address
secondary_email_address.description: One entry of the account's emails array; may or may not be the primary address (see the primary flag).

email_type.label: Email entry type
email_type.description: Which category an emails{} entry belongs to: custom, home, other or work.

email_custom_type.label: Email custom type label
email_custom_type.description: The free-text label for an emails{} entry whose type is custom.

email_primary_flag.label: Email entry is primary
email_primary_flag.description: True on exactly one entry of the emails array: the account's primary address.

phone_number.label: Phone number
phone_number.description: A phone number on the account, from phones{}.value or the TA's phone alias.

phone_type.label: Phone entry type
phone_type.description: Which category a phones{} entry belongs to (work, home, mobile and others the vendor's phones{} reference lists).

external_id_value.label: External id value
external_id_value.description: The value of one externalIds{} entry: an employee number, a license number, or whatever its type names.

external_id_type.label: External id type
external_id_type.description: What kind of external id the paired value is: account, custom, customer, login_id, network or organization.

external_id_custom_type.label: External id custom type label
external_id_custom_type.description: The free-text label for an externalIds{} entry whose type is custom.

customer_id.label: Customer id
customer_id.description: The Google Workspace customer id the account belongs to.

org_unit_path.label: Org unit path
org_unit_path.description: The full path of the organizational unit the account is placed in; a bare / is the top-level org.

is_admin.label: Is super admin
is_admin.description: True for an account with super administrator privileges.

is_delegated_admin.label: Is delegated admin
is_delegated_admin.description: True for a delegated administrator: an account with a subset of admin console privileges.

agreed_to_terms.label: Agreed to terms
agreed_to_terms.description: True once the account has completed an initial login and accepted the Terms of Service.

account_suspended.label: Account suspended
account_suspended.description: True while the account is suspended, by an administrator or by Google.

suspension_reason.label: Suspension reason
suspension_reason.description: Why a suspended account was suspended; present only while suspended is true. The vendor page names the field but does not publish a full code list.

change_password_next_login.label: Change password at next login
change_password_next_login.description: True if the account must change its password on next sign-in; does not apply when the user signs in through a third-party identity provider.

ip_allowlisted.label: IP allowlisted
ip_allowlisted.description: If true, the account's address is subject to a deprecated IP address allowlist configuration.

is_mailbox_setup.label: Mailbox set up
is_mailbox_setup.description: True once the account's Gmail mailbox has been created; only applicable when the account holds a Gmail license.

include_in_gal.label: Included in global address list
include_in_gal.description: True if the account's profile is visible in the domain's global address list, where contact sharing is enabled.

hash_function.label: Password hash function
hash_function.description: Which hash format the password value uses.

last_login_time.label: Last login time
last_login_time.description: The last time the account signed in.

managed_by.label: Managed by
managed_by.description: An indexed column on gws:users:identity; empty on both captured sample events, so its source path and meaning could not be confirmed.

address_type.label: Address entry type
address_type.description: Which category an addresses{} entry belongs to: custom, home, other or work.

address_custom_type.label: Address custom type label
address_custom_type.description: The free-text label for an addresses{} entry whose type is custom.

address_locality.label: Address locality
address_locality.description: The city or locality of an addresses{} entry.

address_region.label: Address region
address_region.description: The state or region of an addresses{} entry.

address_postal_code.label: Address postal code
address_postal_code.description: The postal code of an addresses{} entry.

address_street.label: Address street
address_street.description: The street address of an addresses{} entry.

im_handle.label: IM handle
im_handle.description: The instant-messenger handle of an ims{} entry.

im_type.label: IM entry type
im_type.description: Which category an ims{} entry belongs to. The vendor page states this pattern for emails{} and addresses{} (custom, home, other, work) but does not itself enumerate ims{}.type's values; inferred by analogy with those two arrays, not confirmed for ims{} specifically.

im_protocol.label: IM protocol
im_protocol.description: Which messenger protocol an ims{} entry uses (the vendor's ims{} reference lists aim, custom_protocol, gtalk, icq, jabber, msn, net_meeting, qq, skype and yahoo).

im_primary_flag.label: IM entry is primary
im_primary_flag.description: True on the account's primary ims{} entry.

org_name.label: Organization name
org_name.description: The name of an organizations{} entry.

org_title.label: Organization title
org_title.description: The job title of an organizations{} entry.

org_primary_flag.label: Organization entry is primary
org_primary_flag.description: True on the account's primary organizations{} entry, per the samples; the fetched vendor page names title, department, name, domain, cost center and location for organizations{} but not a primary flag.

org_custom_type.label: Organization custom type label
org_custom_type.description: The free-text label for an organizations{} entry whose type is custom, per the samples; not named on the fetched vendor page.

org_description.label: Organization description
org_description.description: The free-text description of an organizations{} entry, per the samples; not named on the fetched vendor page.

publish_time.label: Publish time
publish_time.description: The Pub/Sub delivery time the modinput wraps the message with; not part of the Directory API User resource. On the getuser.json sample it was mechanically derived from the user's own creationTime (no vendor-published value exists to draw from).

gws:users:identity.description: The Splunk Add-on for Google Workspace's own user-identity input: one JSON event per Directory API user, indexed close to the API's own field names (name.givenName, emails{}.address).
gws:users:identity.note: The TA also emits convenience top-level aliases (email, first, last, identity) alongside the nested JSON path fields; both carry the same value (confirmed on the dev Splunk index, 2026-09-19).

google:gcp:gsuite:admin:directory:users.description: The Splunk Add-on for Google Cloud Platform's Pub/Sub modinput, routed to this sourcetype for Directory API user messages: the User resource wrapped as the data key of a Pub/Sub envelope ({publish_time, data: <User>}).
google:gcp:gsuite:admin:directory:users.note: Nested fields land as data.<path> (data.name.givenName, data.emails{}.address). Time is publish_time (epoch seconds, Pub/Sub delivery time), not an indexed _time field from the resource itself; index_time_ok is false for this sourcetype per the sample's own entry.json.

The Pub/Sub RestParcel envelope's own publish_time key (bin/splunk_ta_gcp/modinputs/pubsub.py per this sample's entry.json); on this sample it has no vendor-published value and was mechanically derived from data.creationTime.

names_not_stable.text: primaryEmail, the name fields and the alias lists are set by an admin and change on rename or re-provisioning; the id field is the stable key across a name or email change.

time_basis.text: creationTime, lastLoginTime and suspensionTime describe the account's own history, not when this record was captured. On the Pub/Sub container, publish_time is the capture time and lags the account event it reports.

directory_snapshot_time.text: Every field here describes the current state of the account, not an event. Two pulls of the same user return different creationTime-adjacent fields (lastLoginTime especially) with no record of what changed between them.

id_vs_email_alike.text: id and primaryEmail (also exposed as email/identity) both read as 'the user's identifier' but differ: id is the directory-issued key and outlives a rename; primaryEmail changes when an admin changes it. Key joins on id, not on the email columns.

external_id_type_dependent.text: externalIds{}.value carries whatever externalIds{}.type says it is (an employee number, a login id, a network id); the two captured samples hold an employee number and a contractor license number in the same column under different type values. Read type before value.

kind_wire_mismatch.text: Both captured samples carry kind=directory#user; the current REST reference documents the User resource's kind as admin#directory#user. Treat kind as informational only, not a filter to match on.

placeholder_example.text: The vendor's own published example User resource uses prose placeholder text for id ('the unique user id'), externalIds{}.value ('employee number') and phones{}.value ('+1 nnn nnn nnnn'); both sample datasets in this pack copy that text verbatim, so these columns carry placeholder strings, not real-looking values.
